note: Lenses the audit dispatches per fix. 'retire' and 'double' are written by window.py score from measured yield (0 findings twice = retire, >=2 = dispatch twice); the auditor prunes retired entries once they are gone from the roster.

lenses.tester/boundaries: empty / 0 / 1 / negative / very large / unicode / exactly-at-threshold inputs
lenses.tester/state: duplicate events, out-of-order timestamps, partial writes, re-entry, migration of old data
lenses.tester/oracle: an independent recomputation of the same number by a different method or source
lenses.tester/faults: missing file, unreadable file, truncated JSON, killed process, no network, permission denied
lenses.tester/hostile-input: paths with spaces/quotes/newlines, shell metacharacters, absurd lengths, injection
lenses.tester/recovery: does the failure leave the system worse: half-written baselines, locked rows, orphaned timers
lenses.redteam/abuse: trust boundary and blast radius: what an attacker who reaches this input can do as this user
